text:
Evan (Support): heads-up  seeing a short spike of provisioning failures affecting a handful of trials (Rivermark, Lattice, Meridian). UI shows "activation_pending" and some 500s on /v1/provision. Rivermark renewal review in 72h so marking as urgent.

Priya (CS): copying Marta + Noah. Evan, drop any request ids and a quick summary of impact (which tenants and how many users blocked). We'll prep a calm customer note and a mitigation plan.

Evan (Support): sample logs: 
```
2026-11-09T10:22:11Z ERROR provisioner: quota_alloc failed req=req_rv92 tenant=rivermark
2026-11-09T10:22:12Z ERROR cache: lease timeout req=req_lt34 tenant=lattice
2026-11-09T10:22:13Z WARN proxy: upstream 502 -> meridian webhook
```
Rough impact: ~14 trial tenants hit, ~6 appear to be high-touch. Some customers report repeated retry toasts.

infra-bot: We observed a degraded provisioning path due to a recent config tweak to the allocator. Mitigation in progress: rollback allocator change + restart workers. ETA ~20-30m. Will run targeted re-provisions after stabilization.

Marta (CS Ops): I'll flag Rivermark in CRM as renewal-risk and prepare a short outreach template. Draft message below, keep it concise and reassuring: 

"Hi <Name>, quick update from Redwood: we're investigating an internal provisioning issue that may delay activation. Engineers are deploying a fix now; we can run a manual provisioning for your tenant immediately and schedule a 15-min check-in if helpful. If activation isn't complete within 24 hours we will extend your trial by 7 days. Apologies for the interruption and thanks for your patience. - Marta, CS Ops"

Noah (Sales): I'm on Rivermark's renewal call in 72h. Please CC me on any outreach. Don't promise account-level credits without looping sales; a 7-day extension is fine as a standard.

Priya (CS): Good. Also prepare a short internal comms that Sales can use on the call: mention manual provisioning available and the extension policy. Evan: is there a manual bypass we can use for VIPs?

Evan (Support): Manual workaround that has worked for a subset: admin console -> Tenants -> Actions -> Manual provision OR CLI: 
```
./admin tools provision --tenant <tenant_id> --force
```
Note: audit logs will record admin id; use for VIPs only. Some older tenants required a two-step migrate+provision via ./admin migrate --tenant <tenant_id> --mode manual && ./admin tools provision --tenant <tenant_id>.

infra-bot: Rollback applied; worker restart started. Provisioning success rate improving (baseline -> ~94% over last 10m). Still monitoring for any residual 5xx or webhook 502s.

Marta (CS Ops): Action items: 1) Marta send the outreach to Rivermark + other flagged tenants (cc Noah); 2) Priya update CRM renewal flag and record mitigation; 3) Evan run manual provision for VIP tenants who request it and report back; 4) Noah hold on negotiation until we confirm health. I'll also add the comms template to #customer-success-ops.

Priya (CS): I'll draft the CRM note and schedule a quick sync with Sales if Rivermark requests credits. Keep messages short and factual.

Evan (Support): Patch finished and workers back up. Activation success now ~99% in the last 15m. Running a final sweep for long-tail failures and will post when complete.

Noah (Sales): thanks. I'll be on the Rivermark call and will coordinate any credit decisions with Marcus in sales leadership if they request more than the standard extension.

Marta (CS Ops): Final: outreach sent to flagged tenants, Rivermark asked for manual provision which Evan ran and validated. CRM renewal flag updated and post-incident note queued. Closing thread but will monitor replies. :thumbsup:
